# Minecraft-Modrinth-Downloader

Script enabling download of Fabric mods from Modrinth for a specified version of Minecraft.

## Setting up the script
On execution, the script will ask for the desired minecraft version,
simply enter the version number such as `1.21.11` or `26.2`

To change loader, edit the variable `LOADER = "fabric"` to `forge`, `neoforge`, `quilt` or other inside the script.

The list of mods to download need to be entered in the variables `CRITICAL_MODS = []` and `OPTIONAL_MODS = []`.
* Critical and Optional mods definition are used in the Summary report generated by the script after the download allowing you to quickly see if a critical mod failed to download.
* For example, Fabric API at https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api should be written as `"fabric-api"` including `""` with each mod split by a `,`.

## Launching the script
To launch the script, you will need to have python installed. You can download the latest version from https://www.python.org/downloads/.

To lauch the script double click it from your file explorer.

On execution, the script will ask for the desired minecraft version,
simply enter the version number such as `1.21.11` or `26.2`

The script will automatically follow this stability priority in order to download the latest version of the mod for the specified version:\
Release → Beta → Alpha 

## Summary report
Once the script has finished, a summary of the downloaded mods will be generated.
* The summary specify if a mod was successfully downloaded or not and the verion type downloaded (Release, Beta or Alpha).
* Mods are split between Critical and Optionnal in the summary to help identify missing critical mods such as dependencies or other.
